title: ASEP assurance: cost
description: Cost per accepted task and per review, and the share of reviews whose cost is known.

list.name: organization_id
list.label: Organization
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT organization_id FROM metric_snapshots_latest ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT organization_id FROM metric_snapshots_latest ORDER BY 1

list.name: project_id
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_id FROM metric_snapshots_latest WHERE organization_id = '$organization_id' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT project_id FROM metric_snapshots_latest WHERE organization_id = '$organization_id' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost per accepted task (USD)
panels.description: Metric cost_per_accepted_task from the measurement dictionary: the latest snapshot version per window. A null value carries its reason.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT window_end AS "time", value, null_reason, snapshot_version
FROM metric_snapshots_latest
WHERE organization_id = '$organization_id'
  AND project_id = '$project_id'
  AND metric_name = 'cost_per_accepted_task'
  AND dictionary_version = '1.1.0'
  AND dimensions = '{}'::jsonb
  AND $__timeFilter(window_end)
ORDER BY window_end
